detail: Full summary: Hand-writing JSON records into a sqlite-backed .twining/records/ tree is NOT a safe workaround for a misrouted store. The sqlite db is the live store and records/ is the mirrored export; files dropped in by hand are not ingested until something calls the record-ingest path, so the store and its mirror silently disagree. The dispatched subagent was explicitly forbidden from attempting this.
